name: Boneshale
lore: It was a shape before this was stone. The stone is the only part of it that is still here.
prompt: Upright slab of grey layered shale with a fossil skeleton weathering out of it, the pale stone bones standing proud of the surface in a curled sleeping shape, the slab cracked along its bedding planes and rock dust falling where the bones flex
